name: Haus am Schönbach
beschreibung:
Peacefully situated along the bubbling brook in St. Anton am Arlberg, this charming guesthouse provides comfortable rooms and attentive hospitality. It is a wonderful base for skiers and hikers.

The Galzigbahn and Rendlbahn cable cars and the bustling village center are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus am Schoenbach in St. Anton am Arlberg offers cosy accommodation in the cradle of alpine skiing.
